The '''Czerka Mark 4 Droid''' was an [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model manufactured by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]]. Such droids were guarding the [[Jundland Czerka facility]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TOR" />
